intent: Durable product activation mode ACCOUNT / LICENSE_KEY / EITHER. Preserve legacy key-only signed issuance without Google login; prevent account-product JWS for key-only products and prevent key issuance/refresh/reveal for account-only products. Additive Product migration, locked post-publication policy, no production changes. Core database job independently runs SQL-owned policy integration with disposable PostgreSQL; PR admission stays DB-free.
